definitions.explanation: A painting created using oil-based paints, or the art form itself.

examples.japanese: {美術館|びじゅつかん}で{油絵|あぶらえ}を{鑑賞|かんしょう}した。
examples.english: I viewed oil paintings at the art museum.

examples.japanese: {趣味|しゅみ}で{油絵|あぶらえ}を{描|か}いている。
examples.english: I paint oil paintings as a hobby.

examples.japanese: この{油絵|あぶらえ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{画家|がか}の{作品|さくひん}だ。
examples.english: This oil painting is a work by a famous painter.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{油絵|あぶらえ}を{描|か}く (to paint an oil painting)
・{油絵|あぶらえ}の{具|ぐ} (oil paints)
・{油絵|あぶらえ}{教室|きょうしつ} (oil painting class)
・{油絵|あぶらえ}{展|てん} (oil painting exhibition)

RELATED ART TERMS:
・{水彩画|すいさいが} (watercolor painting)
・{日本画|にほんが} (Japanese-style painting)
・{版画|はんが} (printmaking)
・{油彩|ゆさい} (oil painting - technical term)

MATERIALS:
・キャンバス (canvas)
・イーゼル (easel)
・{筆|ふで} (brush)
